notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618934/21f4e3c57d881e1f016602edbacf5d105eb03210.png[/img]

Hey, W.A.N.D. wielders! 
Patch 1.0.2 is live, bringing gameplay tweaks, balance adjustments, and some new features to improve your experience. 

Here’s what’s new:

[b]🕹️ Gameplay Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Dash cooldown now starts after the dash finishes for smoother movement.
[*] Gain Essence and Heal effects only trigger on enemy hits (heal slightly buffed).
[*] Running Barrels will now spawn during the boss wave for added chaos!
[*] More enemies have been added to Shibuya after completion.
[/list]

[b]⚖️ Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Rina's movement speed and dash distance buffed for faster gameplay.
[*] Sonic Shield retrigger is stronger.
[*] Minimum dash cooldown slightly increased for better pacing.
[*] Cast with Dash skill buffed to encourage faster spell-casting combos.
[/list]

[b]🌐 Localization[/b]
[list]
[*] Japanese localization updated to improve accuracy and immersion.
[/list]

[b]⚙️ New Options[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an option to disable dialogues for a faster-paced experience.
[*] Screen mode options added (Windowed, Fullscreen, Borderless).
[/list]

[b]🛠️ Minor Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game threw an error if the gamepad disconnected during the intro.
[*] Running Barrels will now respawn with a slight delay to avoid instant chaos.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
We hope these updates make your spell-crafting journey even more enjoyable! ✨ 
If you have any feedback, drop it in the comments or discussions.

As always, thank you for your support, and happy spell-crafting! 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2581750/WAND_Project/

notes.title: Is the tutorial clear enough?
notes.content:
It shouldn't surprise anyone that tutorials serve as an introduction to the game, mechanically (what features are available) and narratively (Where are we? Who are we?). They’re responsible for the game's first impression on the player and for teaching the player the ropes, ensuring they can enjoy the game “as Designers intended.” 

Yet, despite being very complicated, there are games that have no tutorials whatsoever and still work perfectly fine (Noita is a great example). But what does it look like in the case of the W.A.N.D. Project?
[h2]Explain everything or just some elements?[/h2]

The question in the headline is extremely important and addressed not only to us but also to you! [b]Our W.A.N.D. Project is not the easiest game, but the rules of gameplay on each map seem obvious.[/b] However, spellcrafting looks problematic, and we hear that not everyone understands what it is all about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618934/acb24b6a7403c990d22c8d610006d32553b20aa7.jpg[/img]
We tried to highlight individual modules with separate colours. [b]We've also added a tutorial showing how to set up the spell correctly.[/b] However, most of you create one long spell without trying to make several shorter ones. Also, retriggers need to be clarified, and you don't know why specific effects sometimes don't work and other times they run without any problems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618934/3c05103e140df7e6617be6f4536941756e965505.jpg[/img]
What now? We're working on a better tutorial that shows how the main attraction works in W.A.N.D. Project. [b]We want you to know exactly how spellcrafting works at the release.[/b] We will provide more accurate descriptions of the effects as well as other details. However, we also want to make sure to keep you from being overwhelmed with too much information because that is also unproductive!

If you have any comments or suggestions about the tutorial, what you would like to know or what we should focus on when explaining how it works, [url=https://discord.gg/zvaGSgfEuS]let us know on Discord[/url]. We are there for you.

notes.title: How about making the game more challenging?
notes.content:
Who likes challenging games? Hands up! There will definitely be a few people who simply want to push themselves. That's why we've prepared [b]special challenges[/b] that will make saving Tokyo much more difficult!

[h2]A challenge (not) for everyone[/h2]
To be clear, the disruptions in W.A.N.D. Project are [b]optional[/b]. You don't have to use them at all. The game itself is challenging, and we're building it with the idea that you'll have to try to experiment with your spells. However, you can always raise the bar if you want!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618934/6ff7af17b5cb0efc2ccae23241ae276da7d7c3e5.jpg[/img]
By selecting a modifier, you will receive [b]a bonus[/b] to the meta currency you receive. This is our way of rewarding you for wanting to make the game more difficult. At the same time, these values ​​are not so huge, so that no one would think this is the optimal way to develop the magicboard. It’s a bonus, not a way to farm currency!

On the other hand, if there are people who can cope with [b]all the difficulties[/b] at the same time, they can count on a significant bonus. Yes, modifiers can be combined together to really push yourself. Good luck with that, tho!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618934/eb3d3684f960cfc9da3235b091799d0e4b0106c0.jpg[/img]
We want to experiment with modifiers so that they are not limited to [b]passive values[/b]. This way, we will diversify the fun in the W.A.N.D. Project. Maybe we can encourage more people to check out the more difficult version of the game.

Let us know your thoughts, and we invite you [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F746Rs9NPzt]to our Discord[/url].

notes.title: An opportunity to play a new map with unique opponents!
notes.content:
Hi! We have prepared a special demo to celebrate the Endless Replayability Fest on Steam. It will be available from [b]May 13 to 20[/b], when you can check out the renewed W.A.N.D. Project. I'm not exaggerating because you'll immediately notice that the game looks different!

[previewyoutube=888FcXhV-mo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]New map, new enemies and a new look[/h2]
We have changed the appearance of the spellboard so all modules look different. [b]We have also modified the visual aspects of spell creation, making it much more readable.[/b] Additionally, the effects of some spells have also been improved!

We also want (or wand?) you to check a second map. It’s based on the mechanics of totems, which you must activate in the correct order before the time runs out. [b]The faster you succeed, the more essence you will receive.[/b] However, it will be challenging because new opponents will stand in your way!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618934/580bace71c2c51800cc93bbd6ff8aa0661d9ef8a.jpg[/img]
[h2]Metaprogression, manual aim and pads[/h2]
I mentioned that W.A.N.D. Project can be played on pads. [b]Now it's even more fun, just like playing on Steam Deck.[/b] Don't forget to go into the settings to check how the game works with manual aiming and shooting. These two options make the game look completely different.

We also changed the meta progression. [b]For a special currency, you can unlock spellboard slots for the selected heroine and strengthen bonus stones.[/b] This way, you become stronger with each approach, increasing your capabilities.

The new demo will be available [b]until May 20[/b], so check it out while you can. After this time, we will restore the old demo on Steam with new graphics as a gift!

So, [url=https://discord.com/invite/4cpzCT95fV]join our Discord[/url] and remember to save Tokyo!

notes.title: To forge, or not to forge?
notes.content:
Hi!
This time we wanted to enchant you (pun intended) with something other than just creating your own spells. We have already talked about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2581750/view/3737482343881769140]spellcrafting[/url] in W.A.N.D. Project, but this is not the only aspect of magic in our game. So this time we're going to shed some light on forge mechanics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618934/0eff302a030c7ba2aca3c7c984314761a683e849.gif[/img]

[h2]Forge is your ticket to enhancing spells[/h2]
To the left of the spellcrafting screen, you'll find the Forge panel. Initially, it's perfectly fine to disregard it and head straight to the shop, but its utility becomes apparent soon enough. 

When you possess two modules with the same name and tier, you can merge them into a single module of a higher tier. Or you can merge two different modules with the same tier together, to get one more powerful but random. Best of all, [b][u]forging is free[/u][/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618934/d094dfcc2dac9a526e4a4bec1fd0d7b221d42e0d.gif[/img]

[b]There are several reasons why you should consider forging:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Save space:[/b] Often, the latest and most powerful module may not be enough when you're constrained by space. Forging allows you to consolidate power efficiently.
[*] [b]Maintain the perfect shape:[/b] When forging, you can choose one of the shapes from the lower-tier modules used. This ensures that the new module seamlessly fits into your existing spell structure.
[*] [b]Adjust the retrigger:[/b] Sometimes, you may have a preference for one retrigger over another. Forging empowers you to select the retrigger you want to inherit.
[*] [b]Keep cooldown low:[/b] Each module increases the caster's cooldown by a small percentage. Having fewer modules in a spell translates to faster shooting.
[*] [b]Upscale statistics:[/b] Higher-tier modules are inherently more powerful. It's essential to note that you can also carry over the "+" quality to the higher-level module.
[/list]
And the most important piece of advice - keep experimenting and have fun! We'll have even more news soon, so follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/wandproject]Twitter[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/x4feX2Fjzt]Discord[/url].

notes.title: W.A.N.D. Project presents... “The art of spellcrafting”
notes.content:
Magic is an art. Sure, you may just use one of the standard solutions like many, many times before, but you may as well craft your own spells! This way, you may express your personality and fit the effects to your needs. Okay, but how to do that?

In our spellcrafting system, we took a simple approach - give the player toys and tools and let them flow. You have to just arrange the modules together on a personal board and chain effects into what suits you best.

[h2]Be the spell you want to cast[/h2]

Each spell starts with a caster. [b]This part is responsible for WHEN you shoot.[/b] Do you like running? Use cast with movement and shoot a spell every time you travel a distance long enough. Or maybe you prefer to hide and barely move while dodging enemies' projectiles by millimetres? Try casting when idle. Are you mad each time you've got hit? Reflect it with a powerful cast with pain, which has no time restrictions at all - but it needs you to suffer to activate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618934/589dcb18db6b8e93e16bc71f322916ab4696707b.jpg[/img]

And we have plenty to activate! A single, small, but reliable fireball? Sonic trap awaiting approaching enemies? Lightning raze, maybe a bit sloppy, but which can strike from behind the obstacles? You could use a sonic arrow that can shine when you arrange enemies in a straight line. It may not be the strongest, but it is solid, AND it can pierce through enemies on top of that. 

Or maybe you prefer the projectile to do all the aiming job for you? Pick chain lightning. It can bounce between enemies, affecting all of them. [b]However, it might have some problems to keep the spell going.[/b] You could always deal solid damage with a lightning slash, however, you have to get really close to the enemies. So the spawners decide WHAT to shoot.

[h2]Effects on effects on top of… effects![/h2]

And on top of that, you can add some additional effects! [b]More damage, burning, gaining additional essence, even healing - you could achieve a lot with the effects modules.[/b] If you want - you can use multiple effects at the same spawner. How about stacking damage on a sonic wave around your hero? Or maybe deal damage over time and add a bit of healing? There is a lot to discover.

Each spell must have a caster and a spawner, but then you may add any other spawners and effects you want. [b]For example, you may connect sonic wave to the fire breath to the lightning raze.[/b] With each hit there is a chance to propagate the spell! So, you may build your own sequencer if you want. There are, however, few restrictions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618934/1312edb80b28e66c880b1c3a84dc988d35c3360f.jpg[/img]

First of which is your board itself. Because you have to align modules by their inputs and outputs, physical space matters; be careful not to hit the corner mid-sequence! Second - you have to find the right modules in the everchanging shop. [b]And even then, making your spell chain longer overloads your caster, making it slower and slower.[/b] Remember when I said there is a *chance* to advance the spell? Well, if it's too long to trigger until the end, maybe it's not worth the additional cooldown?

But! Because you have the whole board to use, you could use multiple casters and make multiple spells! They may be short, but thanks to that - it's pretty fast! [b]You could alternate between two spells - one for staying still that debuffs enemies and one for running to finish them off![/b] But the casters take place themselves, ah!

[h2]Upgrade the spell or add another one? Why not both?[/h2]

So maybe instead of prolonging your spell and adding new fancy effects, you prefer to upgrade them? No problem, just raise the tiers of the modules! It might be a bit tricky - you have to find multiple same modules to do that by merging. [b]Two weaker ones to one more powerful.[/b] And if you don't have the same modules? If you feel adventurous, try to forge a mystery module of a higher tier from any modules you want. >>[i]Pssst, there might be some secret combinations! But it’s a tale for the release, not the demo![/i]<<

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618934/5ad0d014955120df335ad0d08c7f449d50087014.png[/img]

Have you noticed a small "+" near some of the modules? You were lucky! They are especially powerful, so try to make good use of them! It can also make your module excellent by merging it with a shiny "+" one.

And because each character is different, you may find different special bonuses on the board of every girl. [b]Try to lead your spell through those slots to unlock its potential![/b] Although it may seem a bit overwhelming, your trusty wand will guide you through the world of W.A.N.D. Project.

[b]And that's just the beginning of the possibilities we want to bring you. Let the magic begin![/b]
